latest_release.name: v2.38.7
latest_release.body:
> ## Stable (since November 10, 2026)

## Changelog

### BREAKING CHANGES

- fix!: validate workspace app URLs on the server (#31262, 2a7bf82607)

### Bug fixes

- Server: Ignore retired OAuth2 scopes such as task:* (#31117, cd3b3df036)
- Server: Tighten up database connection errors (#31850, a8822365f6) (@f0ssel)
- Only add the session token to trusted app links in coder open app  (conflicts) (#31721, cfcd463d5e) (@dylanhuff-at-coder)

### Continuous integration

- Run contrib.yaml secret consumers in the main environment on release/2.38 (#31825, 96c1ca4853)

### Chores

- Use environments for various CI pipelines (#31654, b931f81deb)
- Fix flaky SpendPage.test.tsx (#30132, 8d7c6b53e8)

Compare: [`v2.38.6...v2.38.7`](https://github.com/coder/coder/compare/v2.38.6...v2.38.7)

## Container image

- `docker pull ghcr.io/coder/coder:v2.38.7`

## Install/upgrade

Refer to our docs to [install](https://coder.com/docs/install) or [upgrade](https://coder.com/docs/install/upgrade) Coder, or use a release asset below.
